title: run.timeline
description: Reads the record of the agent run in a pane, oldest first: the commands its shell's marks closed, the calls that wrote or acted or were refused, approvals, reported states, checkpoints and its exit (ADR-0052). Numbers and fixed words only, never a command's text, output, message, path or title. Read from the run's ring file on demand; the core keeps nothing after the reply, and a read adds no entry. A caller in a pane reads its own run and its children's; a terminal outside every pane reads any run, not asked; another pane's is refused and never asked. Needs hello version 2.

pane.description: The run's pane: the one agent.launch opened, or one whose agent reported pane.status. The newest run there, live or ended.

count.description: How many of the newest entries, 200 if not given.

before.description: Only entries whose seq is below this: the oldest seq of the page before, for the next page back.

kinds.description: Only these kinds, all if not given.

run.description: ADR-0050's run id, r<core start>-<n>, or null with [rewind] off.

started_ms.description: When the run started, in ms since the core did, a whole second. A run's timeline never outlives its core, which empties them all when it starts, so this clock is enough.

ended_ms.description: When its program exited or its pane closed, on the same clock; null while it runs.

summary.description: Counters that dropping entries never lowers.

changed.description: Paths the newest checkpoint changed since launch.

dropped.description: Older entries the ring dropped; the oldest held has this seq.

seq.description: How many entries the run wrote before this one. It holds as older entries drop.

row.description: command: the stored row its shell's B mark was on, null without one.

ms.description: command: from its C mark to its D mark.

exit.description: command: as the D mark gave it. exit: the program's exit status or the signal that ended it, null when its pane closed while it ran.

source.description: command: from OSC 133 marks, which output can print.

held.description: command: whether the pane still shows or holds its row.

audit_seq.description: api: the audit entry's seq, its low 32 bits.

target.description: api: the pane the call named.

other.description: approval: the other pane it was about.

reported.description: state: from pane.status rather than an agent CLI's output.

n.description: checkpoint: its number in the run.

changed.description: checkpoint: paths changed since launch; for a restore's, the paths it undid.
